theorems.name: Submission.bf_compact_cover_reduction
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (Q : Set (Rn (n + ℓ))), PurelyUnrectifiable n Q → (∃ Qj : ℕ → Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), Q = ⋃ j, Qj j ∧ ∀ j, μHE[n] (Qj j) < ∞) → ∃ (Z : Set (Rn (n + ℓ))) (K : ℕ → Set (Rn (n + ℓ))), μHE[n] Z = 0 ∧ (∀ i, IsCompact (K i) ∧ PurelyUnrectifiable n (K i) ∧ μHE[n] (K i) < ∞) ∧ Q ⊆ Z ∪ ⋃ i, K i
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
